name: comp-385
blurb: Multi-step onboarding popover that cycles through tips with Next/Start over buttons.
description: Popover-based tour showing a series of tips with title and description. Includes step counter and buttons to advance or restart.
use_when: Guided onboarding flows where users step through sequential tooltips.
avoid_when: Single-step hints; use simpler tooltips for those.
a11y: Button is keyboard-accessible; popover closed on step completion.
